CustomField.description: The logo this Form Template's Banner shows: the Logo Override when it is set, otherwise the org default logo from the Form Builder's Global Styles tab. Reference it in a Banner's Logo Override Field as {{Logo__c}} so every template has a logo without setting one on each.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Logo Override when set, otherwise the org default logo from the Global Styles tab. Use this field in a Banner's Logo Override Field.
CustomField.label: Logo
